card.name: Inside addresses and section numbers
card.fires_on: Partway through a person's surname, a street address or ZIP code, and the decimal point in label section cross-references such as (16.1). It marks a spot in the middle of an identifier that continues.

modes.label: Section cross-reference dot
modes.description: The decimal point inside a label section number in parentheses, such as 16.1 or 2.1.

modes.label: Addresses
modes.description: A street number, building word, or ZIP extension inside a postal address.
modes.example: National Institutes of Health 31<< Center>> Drive, MSC 2320

modes.label: Surname pieces
modes.description: The middle piece of an unusual author or party surname split into parts.

card.writes: Weak output effect; the promoted tokens are a mix of unrelated Chinese and English pieces.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of addresses, odd surnames and section numbers like 16.1, where the item is not yet finished.
